messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — CopperBridge POC today: they want to run a bespoke 30B variant (coral-30b-cust) through our hosted + dedicated flow. Need compatibility + security preflight. Who can confirm KV-cache + int8 path works? Also they asked about KMS + audit logs and an indicative pricing for a 2-week POC.

maria: I'm the AM for this. Target start next Mon. They will push long-context workloads (~8k). Main concerns: memory, tail latency, and cost.

prateek: I can run a compat pass. Do we have the model artifact? Any custom ops or fused kernels?

alex: Vendor says standard transformer with RMSNorm, tied-embeds, no custom CUDA ops. Quantized int8 is possible. They sent a sample tar: https://s3.example/CB/coral30b.tar

prateek: OK running a quick local pass on a dev pod. If RMSNorm + no fused ops we may hit fallback kernels which affects latency. I'll report perf.

ops-bot: Reminder: run compatibility job with command:
```bash
rwd-compat-run --model coral-30b-cust --kv-cache true --quant int8 --region us-west-2
```

prateek: Ran it. KV cache works, but at 8k seq the GPU memory pressure is high with default batching. Need to reduce batch_size and disable persistent prefix caching for the POC to be stable.

maria: Ok can ops adjust capacity? Customer expects ~50 concurrent sessions and ~5k tokens/sec peak.

lenora: Security notes: they require KMS for key wrapping, SOC2-grade audit logs, and a filled security questionnaire. I can own the secQ.

lenora: @maria please send the contact and expected data classification. I'll prep an ATO-friendly packet and baseline answers.

alex: For pricing: can someone sketch a ballpark for a 2-week POC (reserved dev pool + hosted burst)? They want both committed and on-demand numbers.

maria: Ballpark from sales: dev pool (2x A100 equiv) + hosted burst = $12k flat + token usage. Ops to refine after perf numbers from prateek.

prateek: With tuning (smaller batches) we hit ~120 tokens/sec per GPU at 8k context in int8. To sustain 5k tps we need ~5 GPUs. Ops: confirm infra and lambda impact.

ops-bot: Noted. Drafting POC quote: 5 reserved GPUs for 2 weeks => est $9,800 + infra overhead + support $2k. Finalize after perf validation.

lenora: I'll upload secQ answers and KMS onboarding checklist. Quick question: do they require HSM-backed keys? If yes, lead time increases.

maria: They said HSM is optional for now. I'll confirm in the contract.

alex: Thanks — prateek can you attach perf logs and a short POC runbook (KV tuning + batch params)?

prateek: Uploading logs: s3://rwd-temp/coral30b/compat-run-3101010101.log

prateek: Runbook snippet:
```yaml
model: coral-30b-cust
kv_cache: true
batch_size: 2
prefetch: false
quant: int8
fallback_models: [coral-13b, coral-7b]
```

maria: Perfect. I'll consolidate the quote + sec packet + runbook and send to the customer today. Thx everyone :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Security questionnaire link: https://redwood-secure/reports/CB-POC-secQ
